name: Carrion Defense Works Rapid Fortification System RFS-3
product_name: Carrion Defense Works Rapid Fortification System RFS-3
description: A set of deployable ballistic barriers that unfold from flat-packed panels into free-standing walls providing cover against rifle-caliber fire. Each RFS-3 panel expands from a 60x40 cm flat pack into a 2m x 1m ballistic wall in 5 seconds using a spring-loaded deployment mechanism. The panels interlock to create longer barrier runs, corner positions, and enclosed fighting positions. The barriers are rated NIJ Level IV and can be refolded for transport after use. A single operator can deploy four panels in under 30 seconds, creating a defensible position from nothing.
story_hooks: An RFS-3 barrier set up in a Tier 2 street stopped an armored vehicle pursuit — the driver did not expect a rifle-rated wall to appear in the roadway and the resulting collision disabled the vehicle.
RFS-3 panels have been permanently deployed in a Tier 1 neighborhood as semi-permanent fortifications — the community has built a defensive perimeter from equipment designed for temporary use.

physical_description.visual_profile: Flat, rigid rectangular panel that resembles an industrial architectural element or oversized tactical shield. When packed, appears as a slim composite slab with beveled edges and tactile grip zones. Deployed state reveals a substantial free-standing wall with visible layered composite construction and reinforced corner brackets.
physical_description.dimensions: Packed: 60×40×10 cm (briefcase-sized). Deployed: 200×100×10 cm (man-height wall section)
physical_description.weight_description: Heavy handheld per panel (12 kg / ~26 lbs). Single operator manageable with carrying handle; requires two hands for comfortable manipulation
physical_description.primary_material: Layered ballistic composite—likely ceramic-steel laminate with foam damping core visible at edges
physical_description.finish: Matte non-reflective coating with texture grip surface. Minimal gloss to avoid tactical visibility signatures
physical_description.color_scheme: Gunmetal gray primary with charcoal accent struts. Subtle safety orange edge markers on deployment hinges and interlocking tabs
physical_description.interface_elements: Spring-loaded release button on spine of packed panel. Interlocking male/female tab system along top and side edges. Stabilizer feet fold from base. Luminescent deployment indicator strip runs along hinge line
distinctive_features: Accordion-fold deployment mechanism visible as compressed hinge line running horizontally across pack
Reinforced corner brackets with visible welding on deployed state
Quick-detach interlocking tabs with tactile teeth pattern
Stabilizer foot brackets fold flush when packed
Ballistic composite striations visible where edges are beveled
physical_description.manufacturer_markings: CARRION DEFENSE WORKS logo embossed on top pack surface. Model designation RFS-3 stamped in white text. NIJ Level IV certification label. Manufacturing date and serial number on lower right corner
physical_description.condition_typical: Field-worn examples show abraded matte finish, minor dents on stabilizer feet, dust accumulation in hinge mechanisms. Fresh units have protective shrink-wrap. Battle-scarred variants show impact deformation, soot scoring, and puckering from ballistic impacts
